tasks.label: Run Workbench
tasks.command: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $stage=Join-Path $root 'dist\UnifiedEngineeringWorkbench'; $exe=Join-Path $root 'Launch.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { $exe=Join-Path $stage 'Launch.exe'; $root=$stage }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { throw 'Run scripts/package_release.ps1 -StageOnly first.' }; Start-Process -FilePath $exe -WorkingDirectory $root -WindowStyle Hidden

tasks.label: Test Workbench Core
tasks.command: cmake --build build-source --config Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { ctest --test-dir build-source --output-on-failure }
